title: Verify: Poll detection of SCHEDULED and CLOSED Rounds unit tests
summary: Unit tests with fake Git and fake clock for detection
description: Write backend/worker/internal/poller/poller_detect_test.go with fakeGit (records call order, returns configured Rounds/errors), fakeCloser (records calls) and fakeClock types shared by the other poller tests.
acceptance_criteria: Scheduled and Closed IDs are returned as specified.
Pull is called before ListRounds once each.
technical_constraints: All dependencies faked; no filesystem or network

steps.action: Define fakeGit{rounds []Round; pullErr, listErr error; calls []string} whose Pull appends "pull" and ListRounds appends "list"; fakeCloser{calls []string; errFor map[string]error} whose Close appends the round ID; fakeClock{now time.Time}.
steps.expected: Helpers compile for all poller tests.

steps.action: Inputs: Rounds R1 SCHEDULED, R2 OPEN with EndsAt one hour after the fake clock, R3 CLOSED. Assert Result.Scheduled equals []string{"R1"}, Result.Closed equals []string{"R3"}, Result.ClosedNow is empty, err is nil, fakeCloser.calls is empty and fakeGit.calls equals []string{"pull","list"}.
Input: fakeGit with no Rounds. Assert err is nil and all three Result slices have length 0.
